No fields: the empty cells in the Perfekt table are by design (each printed verb sits in exactly one Partizip column; students add new rows on paper, which the key lists), and no blanks, lines or circles are printed anywhere on the page. 5b key answers therefore not needed for any control.

Excluded per policy: red clipped lesson numeral top-right, AB/Beruf/Spiel & Spaß/Diktat/INFO margin tabs, red task numerals 6/7, task letters a/b, smileys, photos and cartoon, ellipsis row in the table, bullets/dots, footer (dreiundsechzig/63), Modul tab. OCR "s000" corrected to printed "sooo".
No audio markers on the page.
